# The Practical Backyard Bunker Review

> Independent overview of the book "The Practical Backyard Bunker" by Christopher Mackenzie. Covers what the book promises, who it may suit, what to verify before buying and general pre-build safety questions. No invented ratings or testimonials.

## Pages
- [The Practical Backyard Bunker Review](https://the-practical-backyard-bunker-review.vercel.app/): main review and FAQ
- [Editorial & Disclosure Policy](https://the-practical-backyard-bunker-review.vercel.app/disclosure.html): how reviews are written, affiliate and safety notes
